saints.name: Our Lady of Fatima
saints.title: Marian Memorial
saints.shortBlurb: The 1917 apparitions of the Virgin Mary to three shepherd children at Fatima, calling the world to prayer and penance…
biography: On 13 May 1917, near the Portuguese village of Fatima, three shepherd children — Lúcia dos Santos and her cousins Francisco and Jacinta Marto — reported the first of six apparitions of a Lady “brighter than the sun.” Through them she asked for the daily Rosary, prayer, and penance for the conversion of sinners and the peace of the world.

The apparitions culminated on 13 October, when a crowd of thousands witnessed what became known as the Miracle of the Sun. Francisco and Jacinta died young and were canonized in 2017; the message of Fatima has remained among the most influential of modern Marian devotions.
saints.knownFor: The call to prayer, penance, and the Rosary given at Fatima in 1917.

sources.text: Vatican biography, Canonization of the Shepherds of Fatima (vatican.va)
